nodes.label: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.rationale: Defines the workspace root and member package locations for the monorepo.

nodes.label: OTel Collector
nodes.rationale: Receives telemetry via OTLP (gRPC/HTTP) and exports to devtools-core.

nodes.label: CompareService
nodes.rationale: Performs side-by-side diffing of traces based on operation name and service name matching.

nodes.label: ReplayService
nodes.rationale: Extracts request snapshots from traces and re-executes them against the simulated backend.

nodes.label: WebSocketClient
nodes.rationale: Client-side reconnection logic with exponential backoff and jitter.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry Collector
nodes.rationale: Acts as the ingestion pipeline, performing initial redaction and forwarding to the DevTools server.

nodes.label: First Vertical Slice
nodes.rationale: Minimum viable data flow from Browser to DevTools UI to verify architecture.

nodes.label: OTLP Receiver Risk
nodes.rationale: Audit identified gRPC complexity; recommended switching to OTLP HTTP for the DevTools server ingestion.

nodes.label: DevTools UI
nodes.rationale: React frontend for visualizing traces, waterfalls, and logs.

nodes.label: TopologyService
nodes.rationale: Derives service nodes and dependency edges from span parent-child relationships.

nodes.label: Replay Determinism Risk
nodes.rationale: Replay is identified as 're-sending HTTP' rather than full state reproduction; requires deterministic mocks for demo value.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.rationale: Stores traces, spans, and logs in 'devtools' DB; e-commerce data in 'ecommerce' DB.
